title: Abductees whose memories come back when they see the cover of Communion

tellings.quote: they'll see the cover of Communion, Whitley Streamer's book.

plain: Some people who believe they were taken by aliens say their buried memories came flooding back when they saw the cover of Communion in a bookstore. Communion is a book by the writer Whitley Strieber about his own reported encounters with beings. Michels tells this, passing on what Strieber has said: "they'll see the cover of Communion."
